title: Remove PDF export, fix Models Save action, and fix duplicate inputs

requirements.text: Remove the PDF export option entirely from the Export tab. This includes removing the PDF download button/UI from ExportTab.tsx, removing or disabling any calls to usePdfExport, and removing the print styles from index.css that were used for PDF export.
acceptanceCriteria: The Export tab no longer displays a PDF export button or any PDF-related UI.
No PDF export functionality is triggered from any part of the application.
CSV export option remains intact and functional.

requirements.text: Investigate and fix the failing 'Save' action for projects in SaveProjectModal.tsx and the related backend call. Ensure that saving a project correctly calls the backend saveProject method via the mutation in useQueries.ts, handles errors gracefully, and shows a success toast on completion.

quotes: Models 'Save' action is failing, please correct it.

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Save' in the SaveProjectModal successfully persists the project to the backend.
A success toast notification is shown after a successful save.
An error toast or message is shown if the save fails.
No unhandled exceptions are thrown during the save flow.

requirements.text: Fix the duplicate Equity Ratio and Interest Rate fields in the Inputs dashboard. These fields are defined in FinancingSection.tsx and should appear exactly once. Audit InputsTab.tsx and FinancingSection.tsx to identify where the duplication occurs (e.g., fields rendered twice or EconomicParametersSection also rendering them) and remove the duplicate instances.

quotes: Equity Ratio and Interest Rate are duplicated in the 'Inputs' dashboard, please correct it.

acceptanceCriteria: Equity Ratio appears exactly once in the Inputs dashboard.
Interest Rate appears exactly once in the Inputs dashboard.
Both fields remain functional and correctly bound to the ProjectContext state.
No other input fields are accidentally removed or duplicated.

constraints: Do not remove CSV export functionality.
Do not alter immutable frontend paths (hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, hooks/useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui).
Preserve all existing input fields in the Inputs dashboard except for removing the duplicate Equity Ratio and Interest Rate entries.
nonGoals: Redesigning the Export tab layout beyond removing PDF.
Modifying subscription tier logic or export quota enforcement.
Changing the backend data model for projects.
